# Skills Index

Short local index for fast discovery inside this repo.

## Current additions

- [markitdown](markitdown/SKILL.md) - Microsoft MarkItDown for file/URI to Markdown conversion, plugins, Azure routing, and MCP.
- [ui-ux-checklist](ui-ux-checklist/SKILL.md) - stack-agnostic UI/UX checklist (a11y, touch, layout, animation, forms, nav) for SeaTrack-v3/karcianka frontend work.
- [improve](improve/SKILL.md) - read-only codebase auditor (bugs, security, perf, tests, tech debt) that writes self-contained plans to `plans/` for a separate executor. Imported from shadcn/improve (MIT).

## Related routing

- [defuddle](defuddle/SKILL.md) - clean article extraction from web pages.
- [document-handler](document-handler/SKILL.md) - PDF, DOCX, and XLSX extraction or document creation.
- [obsidian-second-brain](obsidian-second-brain/SKILL.md) - route extracted content into the vault.
